procedures.title: Folding top trim and rear window assembly: remove and install
steps: (continuing) ...as shown in figure 78 and View D of figure 71 in the manual, then fit the binding caps.
Take off the temporary clamps or fasteners holding the trim to the header.
Latch the header down, pull the trim assembly up tight and mark it for final fitting.
Apply trim cement to the header and the rear side rail.
Unlatch the header from the windshield and tack or staple the trim to the header (see figure 72 in the manual).
Lay the trim onto the already-cemented rear side frame.
Refit the weatherstrips removed during disassembly and the header weatherstrip retaining screws.
Make any needed adjustments (see Folding Top Adjustments).
notes: Figure 75 in the manual shows pad construction (header, bows #1-#3, padding, cover, tacks, screws, liner, staples); figure 76 shows the pad installed; figure 77 shows the left stay strap attached at the #3 bow with the pad.

procedures.title: Folding top frame and linkage: service and lubrication
steps: If the job needs the top trim off, follow the Folding Top Trim and Rear Window Assembly procedure.
To replace the whole frame as a unit, follow the trim procedure and the Top Assembly Removal and Installation procedure.
Oil the pivot joints with light machine oil once a year, sparingly so the trim is not stained.
notes: Figure 79 in the manual shows the frame and linkage construction, with cross-sections of the pivot joints.

procedures.title: Folding top side rail weatherstrip: replace
steps: The weatherstrip is held by loose screws built into the weatherstrip assembly and by neoprene base cement between it and the side rail (see figure 80 in the manual).
